XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic failure to start or immediate shutdown after startup
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | PUMP | LOW | PRESSURE | FUEL | DIESEL | DIESEL FUEL | IGNITES | IGNITED | IGNITION | MIL | YELLOW | SWITCHES OFF | STOPS | LOCK | ENTERS | EMERGENCY | ACTIVATION |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Engine fuel supply

  • Component: Low-pressure fuel pump

  • Fault: After a short journey, the engine fault light comes on and the vehicle stops. On other occasions whilst driving, the engine fault light comes on followed by the activation of recovery mode.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Faulty low-pressure fuel pump

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the low-pressure fuel pump and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located inside the fuel tank
